role: TileEntitySpecialRenderer for TileEntityPiston: draws the moving piston's block (base, extension, or the pushed block) offset by the interpolated piston progress through Tessellator translations, reusing RenderBlocks face emitters.
scope_reason: world.conf redstone = off: no block ever receives power, so pistons never move and TileEntityPiston is never created; the piston base/extension block models exist in native (csrc/engine/render_blocks3.c rb3_render_piston_base/rb3_render_piston_extension) only for the static blocks.

members.name: func_147496_a
members.note: creates the RenderBlocks for the world

notes: If redstone ever ships, this renderer is the piece that makes a moving piston's pushed block draw smoothly between blocks; its progress interpolation comes from TileEntityPiston.func_145860_a.
